title: Four-classifier CNN pipeline grades bladder cancer risk from histopathology slides
summary: Bladder4Net combines four convolutional neural network classifiers to sort whole-slide images into low-risk and high-risk bladder cancer. It was evaluated on 182 independent slides from the New Hampshire Bladder Cancer Study and 378 external TCGA slides, with weighted average F1-scores of 0.91 (95% CI 0.86-0.94) on the New Hampshire set and 0.99 (95% CI 0.97-1.00) reported for the second set. Labels are slide-level class labels and the study is retrospective.
